title: model-catalog: capability endpoints, listing filters, and pricing fields (OpenAI compatibility updates)
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Added model catalog capability endpoints and listing filters. Exposes compatibility flags and pricing/limits fields on model listing. Backwards-compatible: existing /models list remains but gains new query params and fields. SDKs updated.
description: Background: We need richer model metadata for customers to pick models by capability and compatibility (OpenAI compatibility, structured output, tool-calling, streaming stability SLAs), and to display pricing/limits in the Catalog UI and APIs. This PR introduces new capability endpoints and expands the /models listing with filters and pricing/limits fields. Summary of changes: 1) New endpoints: GET /api/v1/models?capability=<cap>&compatibility=<compat>&max_tokens=<n>&recommended_quantization=<q> and GET /api/v1/models/{model_id}/capabilities (returns capability flags and human-readable compatibility notes). 2) Model listing now surfaces fields: "compatibility_flags" (comma-separated string of flags), "price_per_1k_tokens_usd", "input_token_limit", "concurrency_limit", "recommended_quantization" and "stable_streaming". 3) Added server-side filters for capability, compatibility (openai, redwood, partial), pricing cap (max_price_per_1k_tokens), and recommended_quantization. 4) OpenAI compatibility layer updated: adapter now reports compatibility_level and compatibility_flags for each model; fallback mapping for older models added. 5) SDK/Docs updates: python and typescript SDKs accept new query params and deserialize pricing fields; docs updated with examples. 6) Tests: unit and integration tests for endpoint filtering, pagination, and SDK deserialization. Migration notes: Add small DB migration to populate compatibility_flags and default pricing for legacy models (migration script included). Backwards compatibility: existing clients will see additional fields but their workflows should continue to work. Checklist: - [x] API endpoints implemented and unit-tested - [x] SDK updates (py/ts) - [x] Docs updated and examples added - [x] Migration script included and tested on staging - [x] Performance check: filter queries use indexed fields and pagination unchanged - [x] Reviewed and approved by runtime and docs teams
commits: 5 commits: implement capability endpoints and filters; add DB migration for compatibility_flags/pricing defaults; update openai-compat adapter to emit compatibility flags; SDK client changes; docs + examples
